name: Champion Electric Metals Inc.
summary: Champion Electric Metals Inc. is an exploration company dedicated to discovering and developing natural resource deposits throughout Canada and the United States. The firm primarily focuses on critical minerals, specifically lithium and cobalt. Among its key assets is the 100%-owned Champion Electric lithium project in Quebec, Canada, which encompasses approximately 500.66 square kilometers across 980 claims. Additionally, the company maintains an interest in the Idaho cobalt project, situated in northern Idaho, covering about 6,871 hectares through 622 claims. Operating under its current designation, Champion Electric Metals Inc., since May 2023, the company was formerly known as Idaho Champion Gold Mines Canada Inc. Its corporate headquarters are located in Toronto, Canada.
